description:
Cancel a pending order. Only works if the order has NOT yet entered production.

IMPORTANT:
- Use the order ID from placeOrder (e.g. "order-1776164807276"), NOT the Probo supplier_order_number
- Orders with status "in_production" or later CANNOT be cancelled — you'll get an error
- The supplier_order_number (e.g. "1260224369") from getAllOrders is Probo's internal number and will NOT work here
- After cancelling, the order ID can be reused for a new order

orderId.description: Order ID from placeOrder response (e.g. "order-1776164807276"), NOT the Probo supplier_order_number

name: cancelOrder
